scientific_queries.note: Audit and fourth rewrite of SYNTHESIS.md against the register; no new computation.

subagent_note: None dispatched: the round audits the deliverable against its own evidence and rewrites rather than patches.

audit_findings.stale_title: said 83 rounds while the current round is 114
audit_findings.uncited_claims: the register holds 88 claims and the synthesis cited 54, omitting load-bearing ones such as C78 (cross-dataset not achievable) and C79 (granularity is not the driver)
audit_findings.patchwork_structure: sections 2b, 2c and 5b were inserted over time, the very shape the R84 rewrite was meant to avoid
audit_findings.stale_recommendation: section 1 still recommended ranking by drug marginals, which C75 has since overtaken

what_changed.structure: nine sections plus an appendix, replacing the patchwork
what_changed.headline: the usable result is that identity plus annotation beats identity alone and beats marginals by 2-5 pp with the direction stable in 15 of 15 draws, and that the personalisation rule is real but inapplicable
what_changed.appendix: a table explaining the three clusters of claims that are deliberately not cited one by one, so that omission is not read as absence

coverage.note: the count fell because the rewrite is organised by argument rather than by serial number; the appendix accounts for the rest explicitly, which the previous version did not

limits: this is a reorganisation, not new evidence; numerical errors remain the responsibility of the original rounds
the appendix explains why 36 claims are not cited but does not re-verify that each still holds
the synthesis still represents a single dataset
retrospective and read-only; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim; no meta-learning or RSI
next_gates: re-verify the three clusters named in the appendix, particularly C41, C57 and C82/C83, and either fold in what still holds or mark it as superseded
